_about: Shapes debrief/discord.py returns and raises (25-B), for 25-D's endpoints and tests. The webhook below is fake (well-formed, never real).

errors.bad_url: That isn't a Discord webhook address. In Discord: channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks > Copy Webhook URL.
errors.gone_401_403_404: That Discord webhook no longer works. Paste a new one in Settings.
errors.too_big_413: The picture is too big for Discord.
errors.wait_429: Discord asked Debrief to wait. Try again in a minute.
errors.not_png: The share card isn't a PNG picture, so it wasn't posted.
errors.too_long: The message is too long for Discord (2000 characters at most).
